note: RCE-028/029 gates. Thresholds restate the RCE-001 acceptance contract and the RCE-004 economy contract; the gate reads measured runs, never opinions.

cleanCaseRate.source: context-eval run, cases with no primary miss class

candidate.detail: A second pilot is justified only by a router or architecture the first pilot does not exercise. A second repository of the same shape adds cost and no new evidence.

multiRepository.note: RCE-029. Growth is gated per wave. A regression in an already-onboarded repository halts growth even when the new candidate is ready.

waves.name: pilot
waves.entry: RCE-001 contract met on the pilot

waves.name: diversity
waves.entry: second-pilot gate open; candidate exercises a different router or architecture

waves.name: squad
waves.entry: both pilots healthy for the full soak; operating cost within budget

waves.name: division
waves.entry: no repository below the health floor; cost per repository not rising

waves.name: fleet
waves.entry: steady state on the previous wave

operatingCost.note: Measured, not estimated. Cost per repository must not rise as the registry grows; a rising slope means the design does not scale and the wave is held.
